name: rdb-design
description: Design and review PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB schemas with ORM-aligned, version-controlled ERDs and optional SVG exports.

interface.shortDescription: Design and review ORM-aligned schemas and visual ERDs.
interface.longDescription: Design relational models, document them as version-controlled Mermaid ERDs, render optional SVGs, and review agreement with existing ORM models and native migrations without adding another migration system.
defaultPrompt: Design this database feature using the existing ORM and create a versioned ERD.
Review the ERD, ORM models, and migration history without modifying them.
